snippet.title: Tempest Tower Gameplay Trailer - free demo out now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Play the Tempest Tower Demo right now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123800/Tempest_Tower/

Tempest Tower is a unique fusion of tower defense strategy and platforming action. Protect your tower from invading Creepers using wild contraptions, powerful upgrades, or maybe just... jump on their heads!

Tempest Tower is being developed by award winning studio, Half Past Yellow. It will be their first self-published title.
